value.name: Asha presses Claire to carry her to Marcus
value.description: Asha silently lets the tension build and realizes she has asked Claire to bring her into a kitchen two hundred miles away to face Marcus, who lied.
evidence: Asha did not soften the ask, did not offer Claire an exit through some smaller question; she only listened to the small mechanical hum of her own refrigerator and to Claire's breathing, and understood that she had just asked a woman she had never met to carry her into a kitchen two hundred miles away and set her down across from the brother who had lied.

value.name: Asha demands to speak with Marcus
value.description: After a beat of silence, Asha firmly tells Claire to hand the phone to Marcus without softening the request.
evidence: Asha let the quiet on the line do its work for another beat, then said, evenly, "Claire, please hand the phone to Marcus."
She did not soften it with a please-if-you-can or a we-can-do-this-another-way;

value.name: Rosa warns Asha to trust her instincts
value.description: Asha receives a text from Rosa urging her to trust her gut and warning that time is running out.
evidence: Her phone buzzed once against her cheek, and when she pulled it back to glance at the screen, Rosa's name sat above a single line: The clock is ticking. Trust your gut.

value.name: Asha recognizes Rosa's suspicion
value.description: Asha infers from Rosa's changed tone that Rosa already suspects what she is about to do.
evidence: set the phone back to her ear, and noted that Rosa had stopped trying to tell her what the right answer was, which meant Rosa already suspected what Asha was about to do.

value.name: Claire returns to the kitchen door
value.description: On the other end, Claire reacts to Asha's request by scraping back a chair and walking toward the kitchen door.
evidence: On the other end, a chair scraped, and Claire's footsteps started back toward the kitchen door.

value.name: Claire passes the phone to Marcus
value.description: Claire hands the phone off without speaking, and Marcus takes the call.
evidence: The phone changed hands on the other end with the small fumble of a receiver passed without a word, and then Marcus was there
